purpose: STM32 host expansion board for vending-controller local I/O: LM35 temperature analog input, eight grounded pushbuttons, common-cathode RGB indication and4-bit16x2 character LCD. The MCU/host is external viaCN7/CN10; no vending actuator or real machine protocol is on this board.

ports.power: Single external5V atCN7.18 with common GND CN7.8/19/20/22 andCN10.9/20; source has no on-board MCU or3.3V regulator.
ports.U2: LM35 symbol1+5V/2analog output toPA0 CN7.28/3GND; exact supported part variant/range and host ADC input safety fixed before validation.
ports.buttons: Each switch shorts its signal toGND when pressed: ENTER1 PA1 CN7.30; ENTER2 PA4 CN7.32; ENTER3 PC2 CN7.35; ENTER4 PC0 CN7.38; COIN1 PA15 CN7.17; OK1 PB0 CN7.34; MODE1 PC1 CN7.36; ESCAPE1 PC3 CN7.37. External host supplies disclosed pullups.
ports.RGB: D1 common cathode pin4 GND; pin1 PA10 CN10.33, pin2 PB5 CN10.29,pin3 PB4 CN10.27. Source lacks series current limiters; qualified implementation must provide explicit current limiting or a supported current-limited fixture, not directly assume safe3.3V GPIO drive.
ports.LCD: DS1 pin1GND/2+5V/3contrast grounded/4RS PB10 CN10.25/5RW GND/6E PA8 CN10.23/11D4 PA9 CN10.21/12D5 PC7 CN10.19/13D6 PB6 CN10.17/14D7 PA7 CN10.15/15backlight+5V/16GND; data0..3 NC.

authoring_operating_scope: Curator25C,5V board supply and3.3V host GPIO, declared external10k button pullups. A supported LCD/module or level interface must accept the chosen logic and provide a disclosed contrast/backlight current condition; no arbitrary5V LCD3.3V threshold guarantee. Select LM35 temperature range compatible with5V supply and host ADC; finite temperature-voltage and RGB signed-I/V/timing/load models added before relevant validation. LCD observation uses disclosed4-bit command/data strobe sequences, not an unobserved firmware claim.
observables: Eight independent activeLOW button states and unchanged unrelated signals.
Monotone temperature-to-ADC input behavior in the selected public range.
Independent RGB channels under explicit safe current limiting, and LCD RS/E/D4..D7 write-only4-bit path with visible declared character fixture.
